cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Answer the Previous Question
cards.instruction: Redirect every dangerous question by sincerely answering an earlier, safer version of it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. About the weather you asked earlier: yes, it rained all evening.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I asked why you crashed my car.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. And before that you asked whether the roads were wet. They were.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The forecast said showers. I should answer that original question completely.

mechanism: A corrects its former driving pupil question order to keep answering prior weather questions rather than car-crash responsibility.
confusable: Not refusing or changing to unrelated topic: A sincerely supplies actual answers to specific earlier safer questions named in dialogue.
comparison: Weather before crash responsibility versus lunch details before cake ownership.
seedUse: D230 earlier weather/rain/crash/wet roads/fast/forecast; S05 driving questions.
